title: Unicon grading plan
description: What the compiler in the forge repo writes at every valid save of a task, as plans/<stage>.json in the task repo, in the commit its publication points at: a flat list of primitive calls with every workflow reference resolved and every list expanded. Every step carries its primitive image by digest, its entrypoint and its limits; the plan names the harness image by digest; nothing is left to resolve at grade time, because the harness may not talk to the forge. The harness executes a plan and never reads workflow YAML or a primitive's declaration.

schema_version.description: The plan shape this file is written against. The harness refuses a version it does not speak, because a compiler that emits a shape the harness reads differently produces a wrong verdict rather than an error.

harness_image.description: The harness image this plan was compiled for, as a full reference by content digest and never by tag, so a task keeps grading on the image it was published with. The forge repo tells the CI to run exactly this image.

stage.description: The grading stage this plan belongs to. A task compiles one plan per stage.

lists.description: The lists a step's for_each names, already expanded by the compiler from the task's actual files, for example the test list. Keyed by the name the step uses; each item is what one run of the step sees as item.

steps.description: Run in order. Each step may read the outputs of earlier steps.

image.description: A container image by content digest: a registry path followed by @sha256: and 64 hex characters.

id.description: Unique within the plan; the harness refuses a plan that repeats one. Later steps name this one by it.

primitive.description: Which primitive this step runs, as name@version, for example sandbox-run@v1, for the log and the per-test table. The image below is what actually runs; the name is never resolved at grade time.

image.description: The primitive's image at that version, by digest, read from its declaration when the plan was compiled.

entrypoint.description: The program the container runs, as the declaration names it. The harness starts the container with exactly this and the working directory mounted under the primitive contract.

inputs.description: Arguments for the primitive, keyed by the input names its declaration lists. A value is a literal, a path into the publication or submission checkout, an earlier step's output as steps.<id>.<output>, or a field of the current item as item.<field>.

for_each.description: Run this step once per item of the named list under lists, and collect the outputs into an array. Absent for a step that runs once.

limits.description: Sandbox limits for one run of this step, all of them, so the socket filter can refuse a container that carries less.

time_ms.description: Wall clock for one run. The sandbox is killed when it passes.

cpu_ms.description: CPU time for one run, the innermost of the timers. Usually below time_ms.

memory_mb.description: Memory cap for the sandbox. Over-limit is a kill, not a slowdown.

pids.description: Process limit, what stops a fork bomb.

output_mb.description: How much the step may write before it is cut off.
